recent: Berjaya Corporation 在2026年10月底发布年报并宣布第25届常年股东大会将于12月11日举行。公司同时提呈更新股东授权以进行经常性关联交易及回购自身股份。近期新闻显示其子公司 Berjaya Construction 将承接价值 RM675 million 的 Sanglang Port 发展工程。
notable: 子公司 Berjaya Construction 将承接价值 RM675 million 的 Sanglang Port 发展工程。
公司提呈更新及新的股东授权，以进行经常性关联交易及回购自身股份。
公司发布2026年年报，并宣布第25届常年股东大会将于2026年12月11日举行。
risks: 彭亨州当局对该公司采取执法行动。
公司有一项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理相关的公告。
一名董事在闭市期表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为 MYR 2,282.4 million，净亏损 MYR 109.0 million，净利率为 -4.8%。营收环比增长 4.2%，同比减少 3.6%；净利率较上一期的 -8.0% 有所改善。

recent_en: Berjaya Corporation released its 2026 annual report in late October and announced that its 25th AGM will be held on 11 December. Recent news indicates that its subsidiary Berjaya Construction will undertake RM675 million of development works for the Sanglang Port project.
notable_en: Subsidiary Berjaya Construction will undertake RM675 million of development works for the Sanglang Port project.
The company released its 2026 annual report and announced that its 25th AGM will be held on 11 December 2026.
risks_en: Pahang state authorities have taken enforcement action against the company.
The company made an announcement related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
A director has given notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,282.4 million and net loss was MYR 109.0 million, with a net margin of -4.8%. Revenue rose 4.2% quarter-on-quarter but fell 3.6% year-on-year; net margin improved from -8.0% in the previous period.
